genetic_map.averaging: equal-weight mean of the population maps' cM, each interpolated (linear between its points, flat beyond its ends) at the union of their positions
genetic_map.interpolation: linear between map points; flat beyond a chromosome's ends; NaN off the map

ranking.order: abs_z descending, then Store Variant Index ascending
ranking.plink2_tie_order: panel order, whatever the input order
ranking.tie_separation: within each run of equal -log10 p, each row 16 ulps (np.spacing) below the one before it in the rule's order

definitions.spurious_split: a Locus Lead that plink2 places inside a stronger index variant's clump
definitions.lost_signal: a plink2 index variant that the rule merges into a stronger Locus Lead
